title: The Garden of the Weeping Wood
author: Odile Voss
blurb: Wren Thornbury, a debt-bound temple scribe, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
